timeline.summary: Sarkhan's change to Tarkir's history means he is never born, a grandfather paradox; he survives as an orphan of time and is returned to the present.
timeline.quote: Dubbed since then an orphan of time, he was returned to the time stream's present moment.

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Mechanisms and paradoxes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Sarkhan encases Ugin in a hedron cocoon, putting him in a healing stasis.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The "Empty Quarter" (3000 AR to 3285 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin releases Ugin from his hedron cocoon.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir in search of the spirit dragon Ugin, led by an oracle's visions toward a dragon-head mountain peak.
timeline.quote: Somewhere up there was his destination.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a warrior sentry and drains him dry to feed.
timeline.quote: drained him to a pale husk.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin worries over Nahiri's silence and Ugin's absence while the Eldrazi titans rampage on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans were a fire that could not be quenched, and Ugin's absence was strange.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: A Temur band mistakes Sorin for a Sultai demon-spawn and Sorin kills two warriors with death magic and raises them as vampire thralls.
timeline.quote: Sorin reached out his hand and willed the two leathery corpses back from the dead.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin turns Rushka against his captain, who beheads him, and a vampire thrall drains the captain.
timeline.quote: the captain reacted like a cat and struck the shaman's head off with one blow from his jawbone axe.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sorin dominates a surviving warrior to serve as his guide to Ugin.
timeline.quote: You shall serve me,

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: The Temur guide tells Sorin that dragons have been hunted to extinction and that the Spirit Dragon gave the Temur magic to fight corrupted dragons.
timeline.quote: But some say that the dragons became greedy and corrupt, so the Spirit Dragon gave us magic to fight them.

citation.text: "Sorin's Revelation" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Word of kirin sightings spreads and all the khans take it to mean themselves, but only Chianul thinks of Sarkhan Vol.
timeline.quote: Only the shaman Chianul thought of Sarkhan Vol.

citation.text: Alabaster Kirin (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arel dreams of winter's end and finds a seedling in the snow.
timeline.quote: Arel dreamed of winter's end.

citation.text: Embodiment of Spring (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An envoy speaks and Sidisi replies.
timeline.quote: The envoy spoke, and Sidisi replied.

citation.text: Set Adrift (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov taunts the entombed Ugin.
timeline.quote: Here you lie then, Ugin.

citation.text: Bitter Revelation (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zurgo confronts Sarkhan Vol, calling him a traitor returned from fire.
timeline.quote: You have returned from fire, traitor.

citation.text: Despise (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zurgo tells Sarkhan that he made a legend from what Sarkhan abandoned.
timeline.quote: I made a legend from what you abandoned.

citation.text: Trumpet Blast (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chianul attends the weaving of Arel.
timeline.quote: This one hears the whispers.

citation.text: Highland Game (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's mind falls silent at Ugin's Nexus.
timeline.quote: All at once Sarkhan's mind fell silent.

citation.text: Ugin's Nexus (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol visits the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon, finding only bones.
timeline.quote: The voice calls me here, yet I see only bones.

citation.text: Tomb of the Spirit Dragon (Khans of Tarkir, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Sarkhan sends Ugin into slumber in 3279 AR, Dromoka's brood commits systematic genocide against the Abzan.
timeline.quote: Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan, to the point of utter desperation.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daghatar learns why Dromoka massacred his people, shatters the Remembrance and ends the kin-tree practices, forging a pact with the dragon.
timeline.quote: he ignored the dictates of the Remembrance spirits and shattered the relic, pleasing the dragon.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Khan Reyhan is killed when Ojutai, Silumgar and their broods attack the meeting of khans, leaving Daghatar's people under Dromoka as survivors.
timeline.quote: Ojutai , Silumgar and their broods attacked the meeting, killing her

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Dromoka necromancy is banned and the Kin-Trees razed, but ancestor worship persists in secret.
timeline.quote: necromancy was banned, the Kin-Trees were razed, and all forms of ancestral communion were strictly prohibited.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Defectors like Anafenza challenge Dromoka and are killed, but the rebellion gains steam during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The clans of Tarkir wage a conflict for supremacy over the plane that spans a thousand years.

citation.text: "Narset", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Atarka purges the whisperers, stripping the Temur of their identity and reorganizing survivors into a clan dedicated to feeding her.
timeline.quote: Atarka initiated a purge of the whisperers, fearing their elemental magic

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yasova surrenders to Atarka when Bolas's plans fail.
timeline.quote: When their plans failed, Yasova had no choice but to surrender to Atarka.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eshki beats Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead the rebellion.
timeline.quote: Eshki Dragonclaw commanded the Temur rebellion against Atarka, beating Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol uses Ugin's Nexus to travel 1,280 years back to the fight between Bolas and Ugin.
timeline.quote: he traveled 1,280 years back to the pivotal fight between Bolas and Ugin .

citation.text: "Time stream", section "Sarkhan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas tracks Ugin to Tarkir, gravely injures him, mines his mind for Eldrazi information, and leaves him to die.
timeline.quote: leaving the grievously wounded Ugin to die.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Fighting Bolas again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels back through the Nexus of Fate and uses a hedron shard to create the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon, saving Ugin and changing Tarkir's timeline.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan created the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon to save Ugin and thereby alter the fate of the entire plane.

citation.text: "Ugin", section "Ugin's Rescue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol, mind unraveling, returns to Tarkir in disgrace and begins to hear a voice.
timeline.quote: I return in disgrace because no other plane will have me.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan grows up among the Mardu Horde as a feared battle mage and wing leader, scorching clans of the hinterlands.
timeline.quote: Talent with battle magic, and natural ferocity, made me feared among the Horde.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sarkhan returns and the hordechief Zurgo demands his obedience, sending him against the Sultai.
timeline.quote: The Helmsmasher grudgingly sent me forth with a wing of riders to challenge the Sultai

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: in a stalemated battle Sarkhan kills the Sultai sorcerer, finds a quiet point, hears an ancient voice and a fire dragon bursts from his soul, burning everything.
timeline.quote: From my soul, a being of pure fire burst into the sky.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls the name Ugin as the dragon he should have heeded, and hears a voice telling him to find the doorway.
timeline.quote: The world remembers what its people have forgotten.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to seek the whisperers of the mountaintops again to find the door and make Tarkir strong again.
timeline.quote: I will make us strong again.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset recalls growing up an outsider who retreated into imaginary worlds, then undertaking the Way of the Wandering Warrior and being appointed khan by the elders.
timeline.quote: my counsel was sought out by many regarding these matters, until the elders saw to appoint me the khan of the Jeskai.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The imprisoned orcs all tell the same story, but the elders accept that they are lying; Narset concludes Tarkir is sick with war.
timeline.quote: Tarkir was sick with war.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Narset meditates atop a mountain peak, stops seeking an answer, and begins to dream of the worlds from her youth.
timeline.quote: The worlds from my youth rush toward me.

citation.text: "Enlightened" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The Mardu hordechief feasts on the loot and has his advisors plan the next raid while privately hiding his own self-doubt.
timeline.quote: The shepherds will be moving their flocks north to the villages for winter.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A goblin spy tells the hordechief that an Abzan patrol half their size is tailing them and has seen the shepherd camp.
timeline.quote: An Abzan patrol is tailing us, only half a day's ride to the south.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief orders an immediate attack on the Abzan patrol and cuts off the tip of the quartermaster's finger when she questions him.
timeline.quote: who quickly snatched it, drew his knife, and sliced the tip off the pinky finger before she could react.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: The hordechief hides his doubts about the gamble, believing he cannot show weakness if he wants to remain hordechief.
timeline.quote: To change course would be a sign of uncertainty.

citation.text: "The Salt Road" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo surveys the Mardu army after defeating a Temur force and rallies it with a victory speech.
timeline.quote: Surrak has tested our borders," he shouted, "and we have shown him that they are strong.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A goblin protests that Zurgo's broken rock was taken at the cost of his sister's life, and Zurgo stomps him to death to protect his authority.
timeline.quote: Zurgo raised his left foot as high as he could, then stomped on the goblin, dropping all his weight onto it.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: A messenger reveals the Temur attacked because a man calling himself Sarkhan turned into a dragon in Temur forests and the Temur mistook him for the new Mardu khan.
timeline.quote: He…they say he turned into a dragon. And breathed fire on them, took off, and flew farther into Temur territory.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo declares Vol must die, and Varuk warns he is too dangerous, recalling Vol's desertion and dragonfire against the Mardu army.
timeline.quote: I was there when he turned into a great flying beast of flame and roasted your army with his breath.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo plans to hide his real aim by marching the horde into the mountains to punish Surrak, despite his wing leaders' objections.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow, we move into the mountains," he said to them. "We will punish Surrak for his impudence.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Unnatural snow falls as the Mardu enter the mountain valley, and Batar urges Zurgo to turn back.
timeline.quote: My khan, we must turn back. This is absurd. We are riding into a trap.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Temur raiders strike the center of the Mardu line twice and vanish into the woods, killing over a hundred Mardu.
timeline.quote: Fifty Temur arranged in a column broke into our line, killed fifty-six, and disappeared back into the woods.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo gives three young warriors new names for their first kills: Headtaker, Heartpiercer, and Neckwringer.
timeline.quote: Headtaker," Zurgo decreed.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Batar challenges Zurgo for leadership of the clan.
timeline.quote: I challenge you for the right to lead this clan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo defeats Batar in single combat and kills him, stomping his head.
timeline.quote: Zurgo ran his sword straight through Batar's chest, threw the limp form to the ground, and stomped his great foot on the man's head.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Varuk declares that Zurgo's horde fears him rather than serves him, and the horde follows Varuk home to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
timeline.quote: They once served you. Now they only fear you. And that means that you are not truly their khan.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Zurgo resolves to kill Vol, refusing to wipe Batar's blood from his blade until it mixes with Vol's.
timeline.quote: He would not clean it until it had mixed with Vol's.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo kills a dying Temur woman after learning Vol went toward the Spirit Dragon's tomb, then rides there alone.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the woman's throat and she stopped moving.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Zurgo's riding-beast breaks a leg, and he leaves it to die and continues on alone.
timeline.quote: Zurgo left it to die and continued alone.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan wanders the barren dunes of Tarkir, shouting at the ghost in his mind before heading to a distant peak.
timeline.quote: "Stay out of my mind, ghost!" he cries.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset, meditating, perceives the word Heal in the runes of the Spirit Dragon and sees a kirin, deciding to journey.
timeline.quote: In her calm center she caught a flicker, the faintest scent of a word.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Narset below her mountain; she touches his forehead and senses another presence with him.
timeline.quote: "I see…another…with you. Around you. Like an echo of a shadow."

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset demonstrates strength by splitting a boulder with three fingers.
timeline.quote: The stone split neatly, falling into halves like a hatched egg.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recounts his travels since leaving Bolas's meditation realm and his flight back to Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Of the voice that constantly spoke to him, driving him ever onward until he fled back to Tarkir.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset reveals Ugin is dead and that the clans have lost their way since the dragons fell.
timeline.quote: "It is no lie. Ugin is dead. And with him, all his brood, the dragons.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan's dragonfire reveals words on the fragment: look to the past and open the door to Ugin.
timeline.quote: 'Look to the past and open the door to Ugin.'

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset offers to take Sarkhan to the tomb of the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: I can take you to the tomb of the Spirit Dragon.

citation.text: "Journey to the Nexus". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees antlered dragons on Tarkir and realizes that the gate has taken him to Tarkir's past, as Narset's scrolls foretold.
timeline.quote: And it had led him to the past. It had led him here.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to make sure dragons are waiting for Narset when she lives again on Tarkir, believing the past is gone and this is a new Tarkir.
timeline.quote: when Narset lived again on Tarkir, there would be dragons waiting for her.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan embraces the new beginning, calling it his Tarkir.
timeline.quote: This was a new beginning, a new Tarkir—his Tarkir.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: The guide describes Tarkir's past, where dragons hatch from storms and the five clans fight for survival as dragon slayers.
timeline.quote: Here, in the past, the five clans of Tarkir still exist.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas and Ugin, long-time rivals, finally clash in the sky above Tarkir, and Sarkhan arrives to watch.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas and Ugin—two of the most powerful Planeswalkers the Multiverse has ever known—finally clashed in the sky above Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the whispers in his head were Ugin's plea leading him across time, and that his choice will reforge Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: they were a plea from Ugin that had led Sarkhan across time to this place and this moment.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past rewrites its history.
timeline.quote: The changing of a single moment in Tarkir's past altered its future, rewriting its history.

citation.text: Smite the Monstrous (Ugin's Fate, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, flying in dragon form toward the tempests, despairs that Bolas's influence has already reached this ancient time.
timeline.quote: the influence of Bolas had somehow made it here before him

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the circular chain: Bolas killed Ugin, ending the dragons, which led Sarkhan to revere dragons and bow to Bolas.
timeline.quote: Bolas had killed Ugin over some ancient feud.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to climb and reforge the chain, holding the hedron shard from Ugin's chamber.
timeline.quote: If he was still here, still alive, then there was a chance he could reforge the chain.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan breaks through the clouds and sees Ugin flying like a comet, and resolves to help him fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: The shimmering, ghostlike dragon Ugin flew across the atmosphere like a comet, dragging a tail made of storm.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees Yasova's claw-rune pathway tracking the tempests, meant as a guide for Bolas.
timeline.quote: This pattern was meant to be seen from the air—by Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas appears in Ugin's path and the two dragon planeswalkers face off.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas appeared out of a ripple of sky

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ugin roars and calls Tarkir's dragons to his side; they stream out of the tempests.
timeline.quote: Dragons appeared in droves, flying out of the dragon tempests toward the fight.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas and Ugin trade spells; Bolas barrages Ugin, who counterattacks.
timeline.quote: Bolas slapped away half of the assaults, but many of them landed

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Yasova's elemental spell strikes dozens of dragons, including Sarkhan, and turns them against Ugin.
timeline.quote: Yasova's power drowned out the force of Ugin's call, and the dragons converged on Ugin instead of Bolas.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan fights the spell, shouts no, and forces himself out of dragon form, then falls.
timeline.quote: as he forced himself out of dragon form

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Tarkir dragons attack Ugin while Bolas watches, and Bolas delivers the deathblow that breaks Ugin's body.
timeline.quote: Bolas's final blow, the battle-ending deathblow that broke Ugin's body

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan crashes down a crag and is buried by an avalanche.
timeline.quote: He held onto a thread of consciousness, enough to tell him that he was dying.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Yasova's sabertooth digs Sarkhan out, and Yasova begins healing him.
timeline.quote: It was Yasova's sabertooth cat, clearing snow with great swipes of its paws.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ugin's body hits the tundra, creating a chasm at the site of the temporal nexus.
timeline.quote: It was the same place Sarkhan had come to in his own time—the site of the temporal nexus.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas turns toward the sky and vanishes.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan glanced up to see Nicol Bolas turn toward the sky and vanish.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan blasts Yasova with dragon fire when she tries to stop him from saving Ugin.
timeline.quote: blasting Yasova full on in the chest

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The dragon tempests churn with new vigor and new dragons erupt, showing that Ugin's magic persists.
timeline.quote: New dragons erupted from them, shrieking with the simple, unrestrained glory of being.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes the chain has a purpose, thanks Yasova, and is whisked away by temporal forces.
timeline.quote: —temporal forces whisked Sarkhan away.

citation.text: "The Reforged Chain". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jan 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ugin's whispered summons leads Sarkhan Vol to the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas, sealing Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: Ugin's whispered summons led Sarkhan Vol to the moment that would echo down the centuries and seal Tarkir's fate

citation.text: Crux of Fate (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Mardu warrior is set free by Tasigur and given passage through the jungle, not noticing the Sultai leader's cruel smile.
timeline.quote: The Mardu warrior was overjoyed when Tasigur set him free and granted him passage through the jungle.

citation.text: Douse in Gloom (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tasigur sends ambassadors to an Abzan outpost, bringing infectious rats as the true envoys.
timeline.quote: When Tasigur sent his ambassadors to the Abzan outpost, the true envoys were not the naga but the infectious rats they carried with them.

citation.text: Typhoid Rats (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yasova Dragonclaw cedes a portion of Temur lands to the Sultai, including the krushok breeding grounds.
timeline.quote: In a stunning act of diplomacy, Yasova Dragonclaw ceded a portion of Temur lands to the Sultai.

citation.text: Feral Krushok (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun battles Ojutai and realizes his learning has only begun.
timeline.quote: When I battled Ojutai, I realized my learning had only begun.

citation.text: Ojutai, Soul of Winter (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol declares that dragons in Tarkir's skies feel like home.
timeline.quote: Dragons in the skies of Tarkir

citation.text: Dragonrage (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ojutai is intrigued by the maneuvers of the Abzan formation.
timeline.quote: The maneuvers of the Abzan formation intrigued Ojutai in both their complexity and their futility.

citation.text: Whisk Away (Fate Reforged, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yasova feeds Atarka mammoth carcasses to distract the dragons from the Temur; the dragons later purge shamans.
timeline.quote: Yasova satiated her hunger by feeding her mammoth carcasses

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eighteen years after the Khanfall Atarka confronts Yasova's hunting band; Tae Jin's vision of Bolas saves them.
timeline.quote: The band were only saved because Tae Jin had a vision of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol travels 1,280 years back in time to change the moment that sealed Tarkir's fate.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol travels 1,280 years back in time

citation.text: "Fate Reforged", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the past the clans, not at war with each other, are fending off hordes of terrorizing dragons.
timeline.quote: but are constantly fending off the hordes of dragons that are terrorizing their world

citation.text: "Fate Reforged", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets khans of the past such as Yasova Dragonclaw, and Tarkir's history is rewritten.
timeline.quote: The history of Tarkir is rewritten.

citation.text: "Fate Reforged", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the new timeline, Ojutai notices young Narset and takes her on as a student.
timeline.quote: so she was taken on as a student

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset discovers that Tarkir was not always ruled by dragons and learns of Ugin.
timeline.quote: it was not always a world ruled by dragons as the teachings of Ojutai claimed

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taigam confronts Narset, who overpowers him and escapes; he labels her a heretic.
timeline.quote: Narset overpowered him and made her escape

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset's planeswalker spark ignites as she learns the truth of Tarkir's past, but she stays on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Her planeswalker's spark ignited while she learned the truth about Tarkir's past

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset admits her discovery to Ojutai, who gives her his blessing to keep seeking knowledge.
timeline.quote: gave her his blessings and encouraged her to continue seeking knowledge and enlightenment

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan arrives in Tarkir's past and sees dragons emerge from a storm.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan realized that he had arrived in Tarkir's past.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Yasova Dragonclaw, who is guided by the voice of a golden dragon.
timeline.quote: The woman introduced herself as Yasova Dragonclaw

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Yasova's voice is Bolas and that he is coming to kill Ugin.
timeline.quote: The horns of Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas fights Ugin; Yasova's spell grips Sarkhan and Ugin is mortally wounded.
timeline.quote: Bolas struck against Ugin, who fended the Elder Dragon off

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan activates the hedron around the dying Ugin, preserving him and rewriting history.
timeline.quote: history had been reforged, and Sarkhan's life became an impossibility

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "Ancient Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3279 AR Nicol Bolas tracks Ugin to Tarkir and the two fight, leaving Ugin mortally wounded.
timeline.quote: The two planeswalkers waged a titanic battle, leaving Ugin mortally wounded.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Nexus of Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin's spirit sends Sarkhan back through the Nexus of Fate to prevent the dragon's death; Ugin is preserved in a hedron cocoon.
timeline.quote: Ugin was preserved in a hedron cocoon as he regained his strength.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Nexus of Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Khanfall: dragon tempests grow and dragons overtake the clans, five dragonlords and their broods rise to dominate the humanoid races.
timeline.quote: five dragonlords and their broods rose to dominate the humanoid races

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Nexus of Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin's Restoration awakens Ugin and he leaves Tarkir in 4559 AR, lessening the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: the spirit dragon departed Tarkir in 4559 AR, the dragonstorms, no longer empowered by his essence, finally lessened.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Nexus of Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Ugin dies, the dragonstorms cease, and the clans destroy all the dragons.
timeline.quote: Ugin was killed in the confrontation with his brother.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas corrupts Yasova Dragonclaw and battles Ugin, coercing the dragon broods to attack their progenitor.
timeline.quote: Bolas coerces the Dragon broods to attack their progenitor.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Crux of Fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Ugin dies and the dragon tempests cease; the dragons are hunted to extinction.
timeline.quote: Ugin dies. The dragon tempests cease.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daghatar receives Yasova's letter about Reyhan's death and orders word sent to the dragonlord to crush the holdouts.
timeline.quote: Tell the dragonlord that if we move now, we can either force the remaining holdouts to surrender…or crush them for good.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Alesha, Jagun, and Doshiyn encounter Kolaghan, who lets them pass without attack.
timeline.quote: The dragon's mouth closed. Alesha lowered her bow.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Alesha throws down the Mardu khan's banner and decides that she and the Mardu will follow Kolaghan rather than kneel.
timeline.quote: We don't have to kneel," said Alesha, grinning. "Just try to keep up."

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is pulled back through time and finds himself before the weathered hedron cocoon, evidence that many years have passed.
timeline.quote: He was standing before the hedron cocoon, exactly where he had been a mere moment before

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees a herd of dragons overhead and understands that the dragons survived, then transforms and joins them.
timeline.quote: And in his dragon form, Sarkhan Vol took to the sky.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The herd roars with Sarkhan, and he sees changed land with five broods and new dragons from a tempest.
timeline.quote: As he shot back up into the herd, he was greeted by nothing less than the sight of a dragon tempest rupturing before him.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
timeline.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan lands at the Mardu camp and is attacked by the goblin Vial Smasher, whom he knew as Ankle Shanker and who doesn't recognize him.
timeline.quote: You're here! You're alive! Just like the dragon.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms to shield Vial Smasher from her own thrown vial of dragonfire.
timeline.quote: As it shattered on the ground, Sarkhan transformed into a dragon and dove in front of Vial Smasher

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan meets Zurgo, now the bell-striker, who does not know Sarkhan and says no one says the word khan under Kolaghan Dragonlord.
timeline.quote: Kolaghan Dragonlord kill khan-sayers.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Zurgo mocks the name Vol and raises his dull blade; Sarkhan flees into the sky, realizing no one knows him in this changed Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Both orc and goblin stood in paralyzed stillness as Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Narset might be alive in this timeline and heads to Jeskai territory to find her.
timeline.quote: She would be here. She would be alive!

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Eight-year-old Narset, restless in a crowded marketplace, accidentally topples a stack of apples and is told to wait outside.
timeline.quote: She lifted her arm, holding the apple on display—as hundreds more rained down around her

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Free outside, Narset runs along the river and hears Ojutai's lesson across the distance, and asks to be his student; he nods.
timeline.quote: I want to be your student," she said. "Please, let me be your student."

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: For three years Narset trains under Ojutai from afar by the riverbank.
timeline.quote: Over the next three years, Narset studied, trained, and practiced under the Great Teacher from afar.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Dragonspeaker Ishai invites Narset to study at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: To study under the Great Teacher.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset searches archives under Cori Mountain and Riverwheel and learns of Ugin and the dragon tempests.
timeline.quote: She learned of a Spirit Dragon, Ugin, who was the source of all magic on the plane, as well as the dragon tempests.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Years later, by the river bend, Ojutai asks Narset what she has learned, and she tells him she has learned the truth.
timeline.quote: I have learned the truth," she whispered.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset thanks Ojutai and lets go, walking away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Her words were carried away on the winds of Tarkir as she let go.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol travels back in time over a thousand years and saves Ugin from death, securing the dragon tempests.
timeline.quote: he traveled back in time more than a thousand years to a crucial turning point, and there he saved Planeswalker Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, from death

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With dragons secured, their numbers grow and the dragons hunt down and destroy the khans.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, the dragons were able to hunt down the khans and destroy them.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Khanfall: each khan falls and their clans with them; five dragon clans rise under the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: one by one, each of the ancient humanoid khans fell, and their clans fell with them

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The dragons turn on each other and allow humanoids to support them, forming five dragon-led clans.
timeline.quote: After the khans were defeated, the dragons turned their attentions to each other.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Even Zurgo, the Mardu khan of the original timeline, must bow to a dragonlord.
timeline.quote: Even Zurgo—the Mardu khan in Sarkhan's original timeline—must bow to a dragonlord.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset gains Ojutai's personal notice as a child and is taken on as a student.
timeline.quote: Ojutai recognized hers as a mind with the potential for nearly limitless growth, so she was taken on as a student.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset grows restless and begins to doubt that Ojutai knows all the answers.
timeline.quote: she started to question whether or not Ojutai truly knew all the answers to the questions of life

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zurgo, once the Mardu khan of another timeline, serves as Kolaghan's bell-striker, rousing warriors with his greatsword when she stirs to battle.
timeline.quote: Zurgo has been reduced to serving as an attendant to the dragonlord Kolaghan.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's law outlaws ancestor magic as necromancy, and a few renegade spirit speakers hide kin-trees.
timeline.quote: Ancestor magic, once practiced by the distant forebears of the modern-day Dromoka humanoids, is outlawed by the dragonlord as a form of necromancy.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed for kin-tree worship, but a ghostly figure like her is seen fighting alongside the Dromoka.
timeline.quote: However, she practiced ancient kin-tree worship, and for that she was executed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin sleeps for centuries in a cocoon of stone and magic that Sarkhan made from a shard of a Zendikari hedron.
timeline.quote: For hundreds of years Ugin slept, encased in the cocoon of stone and magic Sarkhan had created using a shard of a Zendikari hedron.

citation.text: Scion of Ugin (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed for worshipping her ancestors, though many secretly keep to the old ways.
timeline.quote: Even after Anafenza was executed, many secretly maintained their beliefs in the old ways.

citation.text: Echoes of the Kin Tree (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan saves Ugin in Tarkir's past, changing the future so that the Sultai no longer exist and Silumgar and his clan supplant them.
timeline.quote: When Sarkhan saved Ugin in Tarkir's past, it changed Tarkir's future.

citation.text: Fate Forgotten (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A misthoof kirin heralds Sarkhan's return to Tarkir's present.
timeline.quote: It heralded Sarkhan's return to Tarkir's present.

citation.text: Misthoof Kirin (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan is eager to take vengeance on Zurgo until he sees how lowly his old foe has become.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan was eager to take vengeance on Zurgo until he saw how lowly his old foe had become.

citation.text: Duress (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Atarka conquers Qadat, the Fire Rim, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire.
timeline.quote: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

citation.text: Commune with Lava (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan gazes on dragons sweeping through the skies and joy kindles in his soul.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan gazed on the world around him, the dragons sweeping through its skies, and joy kindled like a fire in his soul.

citation.text: Sarkhan's Triumph (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Idols are forged in the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir.
timeline.quote: The idols were forged during the time of the Khanfall, when the dragons came to rule Tarkir and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

citation.text: Dragonloft Idol (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir, uneasy beneath the sun, searching for Ugin who may be dead and guided only by an oracle's vague visions.
timeline.quote: His only guide now was a cluster of vague impressions given to him by an oracle.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: A party of Atarka warriors mistakes Sorin for a Silumgar death-spawn and threatens to take his head.
timeline.quote: Your head will decorate a spear tonight.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin enthralls a warrior as a guide and learns from him that the khans fell, the dragons now rule, and Ugin dwells in the Haven.
timeline.quote: Ugin is the beating heart of the world. He dwells within the Haven.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Five Spirit Dragons appear during the Stormnexus Ritual to help the recreated clans defeat the Elder Dragons.
timeline.quote: five additional Spirit Dragons appeared on Tarkir to help the recreated clans defeat the Elder Dragons

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Spirit Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Having changed the past, Sarkhan Vol's story returns to Tarkir's present, where mighty Dragons now rule the skies and the five clans.
timeline.quote: Mighty Dragons now rule the skies and the five clans that comprise most of Tarkir's populace.

citation.text: "Dragons of Tarkir", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Known characters have altered fates: Zurgo is a puny orc and Narset never died but became a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Narset has not died at all, but became a planeswalker instead.

citation.text: "Dragons of Tarkir", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan over necromancy until Khan Daghatar is brought before her; he ends the kin-tree traditions and pacts with dragons.
timeline.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza and other defectors challenge the dragonlord and are killed.
timeline.quote: Resistance to Dromoka grew from defectors like Anafenza who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion causes heavy dragon casualties; Dromoka's brood turn to ancestor spirits and rebel.
timeline.quote: many among Dromoka's brood turned to their ancestors

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset finds the Stormnexus Ritual scroll and is convinced by rebellion leaders to use it.
timeline.quote: she was convinced by the other rebellion leaders that this was the best way to ensure a unified Tarkir

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ritual raises five spirit dragons, who battle the Dragonlords; the Dragonlords are defeated and seemingly swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: In the end, the Dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol alters Tarkir's timeline, erasing the original history of these locations.
timeline.quote: The history outlined below was erased by Sarkhan's actions.

citation.text: "Gudul delta", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Kolaghan joins the ban on the word khan and the old clan names.
timeline.quote: Kolaghan participated in the ban on the words "khan" and the names of the old clans

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Kolaghan's reign the Mardu name is forgotten and the group becomes clan Kolaghan.
timeline.quote: the group became known as clan Kolaghan

citation.text: "Kolaghan", section "Clan Kolaghan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kolaghan's brood fights on the frontline in the New Phyrexian Invasion and suffers heavy losses, driving out the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Though they ultimately drove the Phyrexian invaders out

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebel leaders raise the Mardu banner and begin open war against Kolaghan.
timeline.quote: Several rebel leaders raised the Mardu banner and started the open war against Kolaghan

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rebellion grows into a formidable army and defeats Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: ultimately allowing the Mardu to defeat Kolaghan alongside the other dragonlords

citation.text: "Mardu Horde", section "Revival of the Mardu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai has history rewritten and punishes deviation as heresy.
timeline.quote: declaring himself ruler and founder of the clan

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Clan Ojutai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai spares Narset after she finds the original clans.
timeline.quote: allowed her to live after she discovered the existence of the original clans

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Clan Ojutai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan returns to a new Tarkir ruled by dragons and learns he can use blue mana.
timeline.quote: Dragons now ruled the plane thanks to the actions taken in the past

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The New Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains the old timeline to Ugin and Narset and plans to explore the new Tarkir with her.
timeline.quote: He then decides to accompany her to meet Ugin as they plan to explore the new Tarkir together.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The New Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Tasigur offends the Rakshasa and Nagas, the Sultai make a pact with Silumgar.
timeline.quote: forcing them thus to make a pact with Silumgar and his brood

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the other khans and is made Silumgar's pet, displayed as a pendant.
timeline.quote: Silumgar still wore Tasigur's body as a pendant

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sultai subjects foment resistance against Silumgar, supported by dissident naga necromancy.
timeline.quote: his subjects were some of the first in Tarkir to foment resistance against their dragonlord

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Silumgar weakened and Teval's aid, the rebels defeat the dragonlord and take power.
timeline.quote: they fought and defeated the dragonlord, installing themselves in power

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Sultai reject the old cruelty and seek a new cultural identity through the counsel of ancient zombies.
timeline.quote: They found this in the counsel of the ancient zombies raised during the rebellion, who spoke of a time before the pacts with the rakshasa.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan until Khan Daghatar is brought before her and ends the kin-tree traditions.
timeline.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai accepts Shu Yun's surrender, has Jeskai ghostfire warriors executed, and rewrites Jeskai records.
timeline.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every ghostfire Jeskai warrior.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting place to Silumgar and becomes his pet.
timeline.quote: Tasigur betrayed the other khans by revealing to Silumgar the location of their meeting

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yasova feeds Atarka mammoth carcasses, saving the Temur from attack.
timeline.quote: Yasova satiated her hunger by feeding her mammoth carcasses

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed by Oret; Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.
timeline.quote: Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Dragons of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his hedron cocoon.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov arrives on Tarkir and releases Ugin from his Hedron cocoon.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Dragons of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebellions grow under Atarka's cruel rule and surviving whisperers emerge from hiding to galvanize them.
timeline.quote: many remaining whisperers emerged from hiding.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebels and whisperers combine forces to defeat Atarka and the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: their combined might led to Atarka's defeat alongside the other dragonlords.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Atarka's fall the Temur resume their spiritual traditions and nomadic life.
timeline.quote: After the fall of Atarka, the spiritual traditions of the Temur began to be practiced once again, as well as their nomadic way of life.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
timeline.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds this timeline's Narset walking through the snow; she doesn't know him but has read secret histories about the sar-khan.
timeline.quote: About a dragon-man, a sar-khan, who came from something called the Unwritten

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset reveals she traveled beyond Tarkir; Sarkhan explains planeswalkers and that three are in the valley.
timeline.quote: Planeswalker," said Sarkhan. "That's what we're called.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
timeline.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.
